statements.t: We remain confident in the long-term opportunities across our businesses and continue to focus on providing a world-class guest experience, which we believe will support our long-term strategic investments in order to deliver sustainable earnings growth and stockholder value.”

Heath Byrd, Chief Financial Officer of Sonic Automotive, added, “We are taking action to prioritize improved expense leverage in the near term, while maintaining certain strategic investments that we expect to drive future profitability and operational efficiency across our business.
We remain focused on disciplined capital allocation, evaluating growth investments and capital returns against expected returns and liquidity needs.”
Investor presentation and earnings press release materials will be accessible beginning prior to the conference call on the Company’s website at ir.sonicautomotive.com .
